_doc: The Kind Weather at the islet: gulls follow the ferry and stand on her lookout (6.6), deckhouse roof (3.0) and the islet's rails (1.0). None on the derelict: nothing lives aboard the Seventh Terrace. The sea is a solid greybox floor 2 m down, so no fish yet. Placed on the greybox layout (M3-CRE-615); move the coordinates when env-art's kit replaces the blocks (same keys as ch02_haluna.json).
